correctness.rationale: The proof normalizes first/last differing coordinates, classifies all one-deletion collisions into substitution or two possible shifts, proves only opposite-phase alternating intervals are counted twice, counts fixed boundaries by C_aC_b, and sums a rational generating function. Both standalone implementations were run from actual files: direct deletion enumeration confirms totals and every span cell in 24 small parameter cases; a separate interval-construction program confirms totals and alternating overlaps. The n=1 and q=2 cases are explicitly covered. Finite experiments are corroboration, not the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: The exact conflict graph on adjacent-unequal q-ary words is a natural constrained-source synchronization invariant. The result supplies a two-dimensional alphabet/length exact edge law plus a complete first/last differing-position spectrum, a structural explanation of duplicate deletion alignments, exact mean degree, and a rigorous though generally nonsharp code-size lower bound. It is not an arbitrary isolated finite slice or a relabeling of shift-arc counts. Its exact invariant is useful to enumerate forbidden codeword pairs and to benchmark constrained deletion code design.
